description:

Featuring a waterproof design and attractive printed patterns, it helps protect edges from moisture, dirt, and everyday stains while giving your home a cleaner, more finished appearance.

Key Features & Benefits

Self-Adhesive Installation – Easy to apply without drilling or additional tools.

Decorative Printed Design – Attractive patterns add a stylish finishing touch to kitchens and bathrooms.

Flexible PVC Material – Suitable for covering straight edges, corners, and curved surfaces where the tape can adhere properly.

Easy to Cut – Can be trimmed to the required length using scissors.

Multi-Purpose Application – Suitable for kitchen sinks, countertops, bathroom edges, bathtubs, toilets, and cabinet joints.

Product Specifications

Product Name: Printed Waterproof Sink Sealing Tape

Product Code: P05674

Material: PVC

Colour/Design: Assorted Printed Patterns

Width: 38 mm

Length: 3.2 m

Installation Type: Self-Adhesive

Product Type: Decorative Waterproof Sealing Strip

Suitable For: Kitchen, Bathroom, Sink, Countertop, Bathtub, Toilet and Cabinet Edges

Package Includes

1 × Printed Sink Sealing Tape Roll (38 mm × 3.2 m)

Installation Instructions

Step 1: Thoroughly clean the installation surface to remove dust, grease, dirt, and moisture.

Step 2: Measure the required length and cut the tape using scissors.

Step 3: Peel off the adhesive backing carefully.

Step 4: Position the tape along the desired gap, edge, or joint.

Step 5: Press firmly along the entire strip to ensure proper adhesion.

Step 6: Smooth the tape around corners and edges for a neat finish.

Important Notes

For best results, apply to clean, dry, smooth surfaces.

Adhesive performance may vary depending on the surface material and installation conditions.

title: Double-Layer Wall-Mounted Soap Rack – Self-Adhesive Soap Holder
description:
Double-Layer Wall-Mounted Soap Rack – Self-Adhesive Soap Holder

Keep your bathroom or kitchen clean, organized, and clutter-free with this practical Double-Layer Soap Rack. Featuring two spacious soap trays, a quick-drain design, and easy wall-mounted installation, it helps keep your soap dry while saving valuable countertop space.

Key Features & Benefits

Easy Installation: No drilling, screws, or nails required. Simply remove the adhesive backing and attach the holder to a clean, smooth wall.

Two Installation Options: Can be installed vertically or horizontally to suit your available space.

Double-Layer Storage: Holds two soap bars separately, keeping your bathroom or kitchen neat and organized.

Quick-Drain Design: Built-in drainage holes allow excess water to escape, helping prevent soap from becoming soft and soggy.

Space-Saving Design: Wall-mounted construction keeps soap off countertops and makes better use of available space.

Durable ABS Material: Made from lightweight, moisture-resistant ABS plastic for everyday use.

Secure Wall Mounting: Self-adhesive mounting system provides convenient installation without drilling holes.

Multi-Purpose Use: Suitable for bathrooms, kitchens, homes, offices, and hotels.

Product Specifications

Product Name: Double-Layer Wall-Mounted Soap Rack

Material: ABS Plastic

Colour: Black & White

Installation Type: Self-Adhesive, No Drilling

Design: Double-Layer with Drainage Holes

Vertical Dimensions: 17 × 13.3 × 9 cm

Horizontal Dimensions: 26.6 × 9 × 2.5 cm

Suitable For: Bathroom, Kitchen, Home, Office & Hotel

Installation Instructions

Step 1: Clean and completely dry the installation surface.

Step 2: Remove the protective film from the adhesive mounting plate.

Step 3: Attach the adhesive plate firmly to a suitable smooth wall.

Step 4: Connect the main soap holder to the mounting plate.

Step 5: Secure the soap trays properly.

Step 6: Allow the adhesive to set according to the supplier's instructions before placing soap on the trays.

Important Note: For best results, install on a clean, dry, smooth surface. Adhesive performance may vary depending on the wall material and installation conditions.

Double-Layer Soap Rack – Smart Storage for a Cleaner, More Organized Home!
